senses.gloss: ch. (denom. of פָּסוּל) to be or become disqualified, unfit.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 100a:17">Men. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>ליפסל ליקדוש ולִיפְסוֹל</he> (strike out <he>ליפסל</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) let it become sacred (by being put in a sacred vessel) and subsequently become unfit (when it becomes overdue); <cite ref="Menachot 100b">ib.ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 29b:6">Yoma 29ᵇ</cite> <he>תקדוש ותִפְסוֹל</he>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="Q01326"><he>פְּסַל</he></cite>.
